subject: MAP draft: clarify legal edit ownership, turnaround windows & next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes@northernhealth.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@northernhealth.com
Date: 2025-11-02T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo notes + MAP request

Thanks for the demo today, Michael — appreciate the clear performance/cost breakdown. Quick recap from our side and ask:

- We liked the dedicated tier idea for predictable throughput.
- Procurement/legal will need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) listing milestones, owners, and target close so we can get internal approvals. Key milestone for us is legal review of MSA/DPA/SLA redlines.

Can you: 1) send a MAP draft with proposed owners for legal redlines, 2) call out expected turnaround times for Redwood edits, and 3) propose a target close date? We have an internal milestone to finish contracting by 2025-11-20.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Reyes
Sr. IT Program Manager, Northern Health
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes@northernhealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-02T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo notes + MAP request

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the target close date. Attaching a first-pass MAP (MAP_draft_NorthernHealth_v1.pdf) and a redline template. High-level proposal below; please confirm owners on your side and call out any nonstandard clauses you expect.

Proposed MAP milestones (owner — target TAT):
1) MAP sign-off (Sales: Michael Grant) — 1 business day to agree milestones
2) Legal redlines received (Customer Legal: Jordan / procurement) — you to send initial redlines within 3 business days
3) Redwood legal triage & first-pass edits (Redwood Legal: Monica Patel) — 48 business hours after receipt
4) Customer review of Redwood edits (Customer Legal) — 3 business days
5) Finalize MSA/DPA/SLA & signature (Sales + Legal) — target close 2025-11-20

Dependencies:
- Customer security questionnaire results (if any) — may add 2–3 days
- Any unusual data residency or custom SLA terms

What I need from you now: confirmation of customer legal owner + whether you need an expedited turnaround for specific security/PHI clauses. If you confirm, Monica will own Redwood-side redlines and commit to a 48-hour business TAT for first-pass edits.

Next steps:
- I will publish this MAP to the shared HubSpot deal and DocuSign envelope for routing.
- Monica — can you confirm the 48-hour TAT and whether we should pre-seed a limited set of alternate clause language for faster negotiations?

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachment: MAP_draft_NorthernHealth_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
attachment: redline_template_redwood.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes@northernhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: clarify legal edit ownership, turnaround windows & next steps

Michael / Marissa / Jordan — I can own Redwood's legal triage for this deal. A few operational details so expectations are aligned: 

- Redwood commitment: first-pass redline edits within 48 business hours from when we receive a consolidated redline file (please ask the customer to send a single redline PDF/DOCX rather than piecemeal comments).
- Escalation window: if the customer flags a critical security or regulatory clause (PHI, data residency, audit rights), we can prioritize and aim for an expedited 24-hour response but that requires pre-approval from Legal Ops and will be limited to a short list of clauses.
- Versioning: please use the redline_template_redwood.docx so our automation can apply standard language and speed review.
- Sign-off path: Redwood legal review -> Commercial counsel (Marissa) for any nonstandard commercial concessions -> Sales for final sign-off. Expect an extra 1 business day for escalations requiring commercial counsel review.

Jordan — if you can confirm procurement's preferred redline format and send the file by EOD Tuesday (2025-11-04), we will meet the dates in Michael's MAP. If procurement needs us to accept a DocuSign redline flow, call that out and we will adapt.

Monica Patel
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes@northernhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: clarify legal edit ownership, turnaround windows & next steps

Agree with Monica. Two operational notes from Commercial/CS perspective: 

- We should pre-seed the MAP with an explicit SLA redline window matrix (what gets 48h vs 24h vs standard 3bd). I'll add that table to the MAP draft and re-upload.
- If Northern Health wants the Dedicated capacity SLA tightened (lower P99 latency threshold), that becomes a commercial concession and will need Sales + CFO approval — flag that early.

I'll update the MAP with the SLA redline matrix and push to HubSpot. Michael — once Jordan confirms the procurement contact, I'll attach the versioned MAP and set the HubSpot task items.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes@northernhealth.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, procurement@northernhealth.com
Date: 2025-11-03T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: clarify legal edit ownership, turnaround windows & next steps

Thanks — this looks good and much appreciated. Procurement will send a consolidated redline by 2025-11-04 EOD (format: single redline DOCX). We may flag a PHI clause for expedited handling; please treat that as high priority.

I confirm the procurement contact for Northern Health is procurement@northernhealth.com. Target close 2025-11-20 still stands on our side. Looking forward to the updated MAP with SLA redline matrix.

— Jordan
